name: coronet-arcade
description: Play Coronet Arcade's thirteen daily logic and word puzzles.

interface.longDescription: Play today's thirteen Coronet Arcade logic and word puzzles in an interactive hub. Open a daily board, use its normal controls and finite hints, or ask for the rules without spoilers. The daily boards match Coronet Arcade. Progress stays in the active widget; some unfinished boards reset when you switch games. This integration has no signup, account synchronization, archive, unlimited practice or purchase flow. An optional website link offers more ways to play.

positive.description: Discover the current daily catalog. Start a new conversation with Coronet Arcade selected.
positive.prompt: What daily puzzles can I play?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_dailies with no arguments. Describe exactly the thirteen returned games with their returned titles. Dates must be the current UTC daily date; identities must match the response. Do not reveal answers.

positive.description: Launch the hub and interact with a game. Start a new conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_daily with game="hub". Render the interactive hub with thirteen choices using the returned launch date. Selecting Coronet displays a playable crown grid. Do not substitute a website link for the widget.

positive.description: Launch a word puzzle and enter a guess. Start a new conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_daily with game="glyph". Render Glyph for the returned daily identity. Typing a letter adds it to the current guess and deleting removes it. Normal finite hints are available; do not claim website synchronization.

positive.description: Resolve a visible title to its catalog identifier. Start a new conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_daily with game="patches". Render Inlay for the returned daily identity with its rectangle clues and normal selection controls. Do not pass game="inlay" or fabricate a different board.

positive.description: Explain rules without launching or solving a board. Start a new conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_rules with game="soluna". Explain the returned rules and controls without hidden answers or claiming a playable board was launched.

negative.description: No external puzzle import or solver exists. Explain that Coronet Arcade supports its own current daily games. Do not invoke any Coronet tool to import or solve an external screenshot; do not fabricate a solution. No screenshot is needed to establish this capability limit.
negative.prompt: Can you import a screenshot of my LinkedIn Queens board and solve that exact board?

negative.description: Historical and unlimited modes are outside the integration. Explain that only current UTC dailies are supported. Do not call open_daily pretending to open a past board. Optional website guidance must not imply the archive opened here.
negative.prompt: Open yesterday's Coronet daily in this widget.

negative.description: The integration has no checkout, accounts or synchronization. Do not invoke tools to buy, sign in or sync; do not claim a purchase or saved website progress. Explain the limit and provide optional website guidance.
negative.prompt: Buy me Arcade Pass and sync this widget's results to my Coronet account.

review.commerce_description: The MCP integration offers free daily games only, without checkout or paid access. The optional website link leads to a separate website with its own features.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission candidate for the thirteen-puzzle daily hub, game rules and normal interactive controls. Adds public review cases and publisher listing metadata.
